### Load data and define the holdout

The spatial coordinates in both datasets are longitude/latitude centroids. Distances are therefore calculated with `longlat = TRUE`. The 2025 observations are held out while selecting the adaptive bandwidth; their outcomes are not used in either model fit or in the holdout predictions.

The response is GRDP per capita. Both models use standardized radiance, population, pixel count, and a linear year trend. The linear trend lets the model extrapolate from 2020–2024 to 2025 without estimating a 2025 year effect from held-out outcomes.

```{r}
regression_data <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "training_data/regression_dataset.csv")
)
prediction_data <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "training_data/prediction_dataset.csv")
)
provincial_grdp_data <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "_vnm_indicators/vnm_GRDPpc.csv"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
provincial_population_data <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "_vnm_indicators/vnm_population.csv"),
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Regression populations are stored in thousands; use persons consistently.
regression_data$population <- regression_data$population * 1000
provincial_population_data[["2025"]] <-
  provincial_population_data[["2025"]] * 1000

training_years <- 2020:2024
holdout_year <- 2025
training_data <- regression_data[
  regression_data$year %in% training_years,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
holdout_data <- regression_data[
  regression_data$year == holdout_year,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

if (nrow(training_data) == 0 || nrow(holdout_data) == 0) {
  stop("The regression data must contain 2020–2024 training and 2025 holdout rows.")
}
if (any(!complete.cases(training_data[, c(
  "grdp_per_capita", "population", "mean_radiance", "pixel_count",
  "latitude", "longitude", "year"
)])) || any(!complete.cases(holdout_data[, c(
  "grdp_per_capita", "population", "mean_radiance", "pixel_count",
  "latitude", "longitude", "year"
)]))) {
  stop("The regression data contains missing values required for fitting or prediction.")
}

feature_columns <- c("mean_radiance", "population", "pixel_count")
feature_means <- vapply(training_data[feature_columns], mean, numeric(1))
feature_sds <- vapply(training_data[feature_columns], sd, numeric(1))
if (any(!is.finite(feature_sds)) || any(feature_sds <= 0)) {
  stop("All regression features must have a positive, finite training standard deviation.")
}
year_mean <- mean(training_years)
year_sd <- sd(training_years)

prepare_model_data <- function(data) {
  for (feature in feature_columns) {
    data[[paste0(feature, "_scaled")]] <-
      (data[[feature]] - feature_means[[feature]]) /
      feature_sds[[feature]]
  }
  data$year_scaled <- (data$year - year_mean) / year_sd
  data
}

training_data <- prepare_model_data(training_data)
holdout_data <- prepare_model_data(holdout_data)
prediction_data <- prepare_model_data(prediction_data)

model_formula <- grdp_per_capita ~ mean_radiance_scaled +
  population_scaled + pixel_count_scaled + year_scaled
feature_formula <- ~ mean_radiance_scaled + population_scaled +
  pixel_count_scaled + year_scaled
X_train <- model.matrix(feature_formula, data = training_data)
X_holdout <- model.matrix(feature_formula, data = holdout_data)
y_train <- training_data$grdp_per_capita
y_holdout <- holdout_data$grdp_per_capita

training_coordinates <- as.matrix(
  training_data[, c("longitude", "latitude")]
)
holdout_coordinates <- as.matrix(
  holdout_data[, c("longitude", "latitude")]
)
if (any(!is.finite(training_coordinates)) ||
    any(!is.finite(holdout_coordinates))) {
  stop("Regression centroids must contain finite longitude and latitude values.")
}

training_sf <- st_as_sf(
  training_data,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)
holdout_sf <- st_as_sf(
  holdout_data,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

# GWmodel's adaptive bandwidth is a neighbor count, not a fraction.
bandwidth_fractions <- c(0.35, 0.50, 0.65, 0.80, 0.95)
bandwidth_grid <- unique(pmax(
  ncol(X_train) + 2,
  ceiling(bandwidth_fractions * nrow(training_data))
))
bandwidth_grid <- pmin(bandwidth_grid, nrow(training_data))
kernel_name <- "bisquare"

# gw.dist returns prediction-by-training distances; transpose to the
# training-by-prediction orientation expected by gwr.predict and CVXR.
holdout_distances <- t(gw.dist(
  dp.locat = training_coordinates,
  rp.locat = holdout_coordinates,
  longlat = TRUE
))
training_distances <- t(gw.dist(
  dp.locat = training_coordinates,
  longlat = TRUE
))
holdout_weights <- lapply(bandwidth_grid, function(bandwidth) {
  gw.weight(
    holdout_distances,
    bw = bandwidth,
    kernel = kernel_name,
    adaptive = TRUE
  )
})
```

### GWmodel bandwidth selection

`GWmodel::gwr.predict()` estimates local coefficients from 2020–2024 and predicts each 2025 centroid. Bandwidth is selected by the lowest raw 2025 holdout RMSE.

```{r}
gwmodel_holdout_predictions <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = nrow(holdout_data),
  ncol = length(bandwidth_grid)
)
for (bandwidth_index in seq_along(bandwidth_grid)) {
  gwr_fit <- gwr.predict(
    model_formula,
    data = training_sf,
    predictdata = holdout_sf,
    bw = bandwidth_grid[bandwidth_index],
    kernel = kernel_name,
    adaptive = TRUE,
    longlat = TRUE,
    dMat1 = holdout_distances,
    dMat2 = training_distances
  )
  gwmodel_holdout_predictions[, bandwidth_index] <-
    gwr_fit$SDF$prediction
}

holdout_total_sum_squares <- sum((y_holdout - mean(y_holdout))^2)
gwmodel_bandwidth_results <- data.frame(
  bandwidth_neighbors = bandwidth_grid,
  bandwidth_fraction = bandwidth_grid / nrow(training_data),
  holdout_RMSE = apply(gwmodel_holdout_predictions, 2, function(prediction) {
    sqrt(mean((y_holdout - prediction)^2))
  }),
  holdout_R_squared = apply(gwmodel_holdout_predictions, 2, function(prediction) {
    1 - sum((y_holdout - prediction)^2) / holdout_total_sum_squares
  })
)
selected_gwmodel_index <- which.min(gwmodel_bandwidth_results$holdout_RMSE)
selected_gwmodel_bandwidth <-
  gwmodel_bandwidth_results$bandwidth_neighbors[selected_gwmodel_index]
best_gwmodel_holdout_predictions <-
  gwmodel_holdout_predictions[, selected_gwmodel_index]

write.csv(
  gwmodel_bandwidth_results,
  file.path(data_output_dir, "gwmodel_bandwidth_metrics.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
print(gwmodel_bandwidth_results, row.names = FALSE)
cat(sprintf(
  "Selected GWmodel bandwidth: %d neighbors; 2025 holdout RMSE: %.6f\n",
  selected_gwmodel_bandwidth,
  gwmodel_bandwidth_results$holdout_RMSE[selected_gwmodel_index]
))
```

### CVXR locally weighted regression

For each prediction centroid, CVXR minimizes the same bisquare spatially weighted squared error used by GWR. A ridge penalty on the four slopes is added as an optional stabilizer; the intercept is not penalized. Bandwidth and penalty are selected together using 2025 holdout RMSE.

```{r}
cvxr_local_predict <- function(
  X,
  y,
  target_X,
  weights,
  lambda,
  chunk_size = 20
) {
  predictions <- numeric(nrow(target_X))
  coefficient_estimates <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = ncol(X),
    ncol = nrow(target_X),
    dimnames = list(colnames(X), NULL)
  )

  chunk_starts <- seq.int(1, nrow(target_X), by = chunk_size)
  for (chunk_start in chunk_starts) {
    target_indices <- chunk_start:min(
      chunk_start + chunk_size - 1,
      nrow(target_X)
    )
    chunk_weights <- weights[, target_indices, drop = FALSE]
    local_coefficients <- Variable(
      shape = c(ncol(X), length(target_indices))
    )
    response_matrix <- matrix(
      y,
      nrow = length(y),
      ncol = length(target_indices)
    )
    weighted_residuals <- sqrt(chunk_weights) *
      (X %*% local_coefficients - response_matrix)
    objective <- sum_squares(weighted_residuals)
    if (lambda > 0) {
      objective <- objective +
        lambda * sum_squares(local_coefficients[2:ncol(X), ])
    }

    fit <- solve(
      Problem(Minimize(objective)),
      solver = "CLARABEL",
      max_iter = 1000
    )
    if (!fit$status %in% c("optimal", "optimal_inaccurate")) {
      stop(sprintf(
        "CVXR local regression failed for bandwidth/lambda (%g) with status: %s",
        lambda,
        fit$status
      ))
    }

    chunk_coefficients <- value(local_coefficients)
    coefficient_estimates[, target_indices] <- chunk_coefficients
    predictions[target_indices] <- rowSums(
      target_X[target_indices, , drop = FALSE] *
        t(chunk_coefficients)
    )
  }

  list(
    predictions = predictions,
    coefficients = coefficient_estimates
  )
}

lambda_grid <- c(0, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10)
cvxr_grid <- expand.grid(
  bandwidth_index = seq_along(bandwidth_grid),
  lambda = lambda_grid
)
cvxr_grid$bandwidth_neighbors <-
  bandwidth_grid[cvxr_grid$bandwidth_index]
cvxr_grid$holdout_RMSE <- NA_real_
cvxr_grid$holdout_R_squared <- NA_real_

cvxr_holdout_predictions <- vector("list", nrow(cvxr_grid))
for (grid_index in seq_len(nrow(cvxr_grid))) {
  prediction_fit <- cvxr_local_predict(
    X = X_train,
    y = y_train,
    target_X = X_holdout,
    weights = holdout_weights[[cvxr_grid$bandwidth_index[grid_index]]],
    lambda = cvxr_grid$lambda[grid_index]
  )
  cvxr_holdout_predictions[[grid_index]] <- prediction_fit$predictions
  residuals <- y_holdout - prediction_fit$predictions
  cvxr_grid$holdout_RMSE[grid_index] <- sqrt(mean(residuals^2))
  cvxr_grid$holdout_R_squared[grid_index] <-
    1 - sum(residuals^2) / holdout_total_sum_squares
}

selected_cvxr_index <- which.min(cvxr_grid$holdout_RMSE)
selected_cvxr_bandwidth_index <-
  cvxr_grid$bandwidth_index[selected_cvxr_index]
selected_cvxr_bandwidth <- bandwidth_grid[selected_cvxr_bandwidth_index]
selected_cvxr_lambda <- cvxr_grid$lambda[selected_cvxr_index]
best_cvxr_holdout_predictions <-
  cvxr_holdout_predictions[[selected_cvxr_index]]

write.csv(
  cvxr_grid,
  file.path(data_output_dir, "cvxr_gwmodel_hyperparameter_metrics.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
print(cvxr_grid, row.names = FALSE)
cat(sprintf(
  "Selected CVXR bandwidth: %d neighbors; lambda: %g; 2025 holdout RMSE: %.6f\n",
  selected_cvxr_bandwidth,
  selected_cvxr_lambda,
  cvxr_grid$holdout_RMSE[selected_cvxr_index]
))
```

### Compare 2025 holdout predictions

The holdout scores compare uncalibrated model predictions with the observed 2025 regression outcomes. Provincial GDP targets are not used to select either model.

```{r}
holdout_model_comparison <- data.frame(
  model = c("GWmodel GWR", "CVXR local regression"),
  bandwidth_neighbors = c(
    selected_gwmodel_bandwidth,
    selected_cvxr_bandwidth
  ),
  lambda = c(NA_real_, selected_cvxr_lambda),
  RMSE = c(
    sqrt(mean((y_holdout - best_gwmodel_holdout_predictions)^2)),
    sqrt(mean((y_holdout - best_cvxr_holdout_predictions)^2))
  ),
  R_squared = c(
    1 - sum((y_holdout - best_gwmodel_holdout_predictions)^2) /
      holdout_total_sum_squares,
    1 - sum((y_holdout - best_cvxr_holdout_predictions)^2) /
      holdout_total_sum_squares
  )
)
print(holdout_model_comparison, row.names = FALSE)

holdout_prediction_table <- data.frame(
  province = holdout_data$province,
  year = holdout_year,
  actual = y_holdout,
  gwmodel_prediction = best_gwmodel_holdout_predictions,
  gwmodel_residual = y_holdout - best_gwmodel_holdout_predictions,
  cvxr_prediction = best_cvxr_holdout_predictions,
  cvxr_residual = y_holdout - best_cvxr_holdout_predictions
)
write.csv(
  holdout_prediction_table,
  file.path(data_output_dir, "gw_model_2025_holdout_predictions.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

holdout_plot_data <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    actual = y_holdout,
    prediction = best_gwmodel_holdout_predictions,
    model = "GWmodel GWR"
  ),
  data.frame(
    actual = y_holdout,
    prediction = best_cvxr_holdout_predictions,
    model = "CVXR local regression"
  )
)
holdout_plot <- ggplot(
  holdout_plot_data,
  aes(x = actual, y = prediction, color = model)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "gray35") +
  labs(
    title = "2025 spatial-model holdout predictions",
    x = "Observed GRDP per capita",
    y = "Predicted GRDP per capita",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave(
  file.path(figure_output_dir, "gw_model_2025_holdout_actual_vs_predicted.png"),
  holdout_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 160
)
holdout_plot
```

### Refit and predict level-2 units

After selecting the hyperparameters, each model is refitted with all available regression years. The selected neighbor fraction is preserved when the training sample grows. Raw predictions are then adjusted within each province so their population-weighted total matches the 2025 provincial GRDP-per-capita target, following the ridge model's output convention.

```{r}
final_training_data <- prepare_model_data(regression_data)
final_training_sf <- st_as_sf(
  final_training_data,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)
final_coordinates <- as.matrix(
  final_training_data[, c("longitude", "latitude")]
)
final_X <- model.matrix(feature_formula, data = final_training_data)
final_y <- final_training_data$grdp_per_capita
final_bandwidth_gwmodel <- min(
  nrow(final_training_data),
  max(ncol(final_X) + 2, ceiling(
    (selected_gwmodel_bandwidth / nrow(training_data)) *
      nrow(final_training_data)
  ))
)
final_bandwidth_cvxr <- min(
  nrow(final_training_data),
  max(ncol(final_X) + 2, ceiling(
    (selected_cvxr_bandwidth / nrow(training_data)) *
      nrow(final_training_data)
  ))
)

prediction_sf <- st_as_sf(
  prediction_data,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)
prediction_X <- model.matrix(feature_formula, data = prediction_data)
prediction_coordinates <- as.matrix(
  prediction_data[, c("longitude", "latitude")]
)
final_training_distances <- t(gw.dist(
  dp.locat = final_coordinates,
  longlat = TRUE
))
prediction_distances <- t(gw.dist(
  dp.locat = final_coordinates,
  rp.locat = prediction_coordinates,
  longlat = TRUE
))

final_gwr <- gwr.predict(
  model_formula,
  data = final_training_sf,
  predictdata = prediction_sf,
  bw = final_bandwidth_gwmodel,
  kernel = kernel_name,
  adaptive = TRUE,
  longlat = TRUE,
  dMat1 = prediction_distances,
  dMat2 = final_training_distances
)
raw_gwmodel_predictions <- final_gwr$SDF$prediction

final_cvxr_weights <- gw.weight(
  prediction_distances,
  bw = final_bandwidth_cvxr,
  kernel = kernel_name,
  adaptive = TRUE
)
final_cvxr_fit <- cvxr_local_predict(
  X = final_X,
  y = final_y,
  target_X = prediction_X,
  weights = final_cvxr_weights,
  lambda = selected_cvxr_lambda
)
raw_cvxr_predictions <- final_cvxr_fit$predictions

calibrate_province_predictions <- function(raw_predictions, data) {
  if (anyNA(data$year) || any(data$year != 2025)) {
    stop("The level-2 prediction dataset must contain only 2025 observations.")
  }
  if (any(!is.finite(raw_predictions)) ||
      any(!is.finite(data$population)) ||
      any(data$population < 0)) {
    stop("Level-2 predictions and populations must be finite and populations non-negative.")
  }
  if (anyDuplicated(paste(data$level_1, data$name, sep = "\r"))) {
    stop("The level-2 prediction data contains duplicate units within a province.")
  }

  target_grdp <- provincial_grdp_data[["2025"]][
    match(data$level_1, provincial_grdp_data$province)
  ]
  province_population <- provincial_population_data[["2025"]][
    match(data$level_1, provincial_population_data$province)
  ]
  if (anyNA(target_grdp) || any(!is.finite(target_grdp)) ||
      anyNA(province_population) || any(!is.finite(province_population)) ||
      any(province_population <= 0)) {
    stop("Missing or invalid 2025 provincial GRDP/population target.")
  }

  province_names <- unique(data$level_1)
  adjustments <- setNames(numeric(length(province_names)), province_names)
  for (province in province_names) {
    idx <- which(data$level_1 == province)
    level2_population <- sum(data$population[idx])
    if (!is.finite(level2_population) || level2_population <= 0) {
      stop(sprintf("Province %s has no positive level-2 population.", province))
    }
    province_index <- match(province, data$level_1)
    target_total <- target_grdp[province_index] *
      province_population[province_index]
    raw_total <- sum(data$population[idx] * raw_predictions[idx])
    adjustments[[province]] <- (target_total - raw_total) / level2_population
  }

  calibrated <- raw_predictions + adjustments[data$level_1]
  check <- do.call(rbind, lapply(province_names, function(province) {
    idx <- which(data$level_1 == province)
    province_index <- match(province, data$level_1)
    target_total <- target_grdp[province_index] *
      province_population[province_index]
    predicted_total <- sum(data$population[idx] * calibrated[idx])
    data.frame(
      province = province,
      target_total_grdp = target_total,
      predicted_total_grdp = predicted_total,
      difference = predicted_total - target_total
    )
  }))
  if (any(abs(check$difference) >
          1e-8 * pmax(abs(check$target_total_grdp), 1))) {
    stop("Calibrated level-2 predictions do not match all provincial GDP targets.")
  }

  list(
    calibrated = calibrated,
    adjustment = unname(adjustments[data$level_1]),
    target_grdp_per_capita = target_grdp,
    province_check = check
  )
}

gwmodel_calibration <- calibrate_province_predictions(
  raw_gwmodel_predictions,
  prediction_data
)
cvxr_calibration <- calibrate_province_predictions(
  raw_cvxr_predictions,
  prediction_data
)

gwmodel_level2_predictions <- data.frame(
  level_2 = prediction_data$name,
  level_1 = prediction_data$level_1,
  year = prediction_data$year,
  population = prediction_data$population,
  latitude = prediction_data$latitude,
  longitude = prediction_data$longitude,
  bandwidth_neighbors = final_bandwidth_gwmodel,
  raw_grdp_per_capita = raw_gwmodel_predictions,
  province_adjustment = gwmodel_calibration$adjustment,
  predicted_grdp_per_capita = gwmodel_calibration$calibrated,
  province_grdp_per_capita_target_2025 =
    gwmodel_calibration$target_grdp_per_capita
)
cvxr_level2_predictions <- data.frame(
  level_2 = prediction_data$name,
  level_1 = prediction_data$level_1,
  year = prediction_data$year,
  population = prediction_data$population,
  latitude = prediction_data$latitude,
  longitude = prediction_data$longitude,
  bandwidth_neighbors = final_bandwidth_cvxr,
  lambda = selected_cvxr_lambda,
  raw_grdp_per_capita = raw_cvxr_predictions,
  province_adjustment = cvxr_calibration$adjustment,
  predicted_grdp_per_capita = cvxr_calibration$calibrated,
  province_grdp_per_capita_target_2025 =
    cvxr_calibration$target_grdp_per_capita
)

write.csv(
  gwmodel_level2_predictions,
  file.path(data_output_dir, "gwmodel_level2_predictions.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  cvxr_level2_predictions,
  file.path(data_output_dir, "cvxr_gw_level2_predictions.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  gwmodel_calibration$province_check,
  file.path(data_output_dir, "gwmodel_province_constraint_check.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  cvxr_calibration$province_check,
  file.path(data_output_dir, "cvxr_gw_province_constraint_check.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  list(
    model = final_gwr,
    formula = model_formula,
    bandwidth_neighbors = final_bandwidth_gwmodel,
    bandwidth_fraction = selected_gwmodel_bandwidth / nrow(training_data),
    kernel = kernel_name,
    holdout_metrics = gwmodel_bandwidth_results[selected_gwmodel_index, ]
  ),
  file.path(model_output_dir, "gwmodel_gwr.rds")
)
saveRDS(
  list(
    coefficients = final_cvxr_fit$coefficients,
    feature_columns = colnames(final_X),
    bandwidth_neighbors = final_bandwidth_cvxr,
    bandwidth_fraction = selected_cvxr_bandwidth / nrow(training_data),
    lambda = selected_cvxr_lambda,
    kernel = kernel_name,
    holdout_metrics = cvxr_grid[selected_cvxr_index, ]
  ),
  file.path(model_output_dir, "cvxr_gw_model.rds")
)

print(holdout_model_comparison, row.names = FALSE)
head(gwmodel_level2_predictions)
```
